details:
I'll get straight to it World Categories need a major Face Lift when you open the worlds menu it's the same 20 or so worlds I've seen for the past 2 years or so. I know it's a big ask especially for the infrastructure that's required for it, but I feel revamping everythign about how worlds are presented to the user could provide a much better and more varried experience for the users. Here's a lst of items that would possibly make this list more user friendly.

- create a algorythm that generates recomendations for users on a "ForYou"-like category thats the first thing that opens for users on the worlds tab that tabulates the user's recent worlds (Tags, Keywords which could also be pulled from searches [allow users to curate saved keywords to optimize their experience], and time spent in world and how many friends were with them ect)

- Tags need a complete revamp to allow for better searching, allow users to report or vote to remove tags from a select world to prevent abuse of the tag system and improve searchign by tag to include keywords from the descriptions and titles of worlds.

- let users curate their experience by allowing them to select groups to add to their world browser as their own tabs that will give them recomendations from the same for you page but with bias towards the selected tag

- put "pupular" worlds tabs lower on the priority list, not everyone cares abotu what's popular but it's a nice to have.

- allow more options for creators when it comes to specifying what their world is for the algorythm.

revamping the worlds browser should potentially increase quality of the worlds on the platform and also give creators more incentive to create and use the platform and I encourage prioritizing a refresh like this as i've seen it's a common complaint among users including myself.

I do also understand this requires a lot of work and time, Rome wasnt bult in a day. I love this platform and want to see it grow so I wanted to put forward my 2 cents to help improve a major part of my life.

Thanks for reading this far, feel free to give this an upvote or comment any suggestions related to this below as well if you have similar thoughts!
title: Better World Lists (Better World Algorythm)
